title: Superior mesenteric artery embolism associated with Cisplatin-induced aortic thrombosis
description: Figure 2. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography shows an aortic thrombus in the ascending aorta ( a ) and SMA embolism (b: axial view, c: coronal view). The arrowhead indicates a floating thrombus and white arrows indicate SMA embolism. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography also showed decreased contrast enhancement in the small intestine (d: black arrows).
